## Body

Budget the work visited and prepared, not only the returned value.

- **SQL:** `INDEX` and `LIMIT 1` do not prove a bounded candidate walk. #189 at `703cde7` filtered idle activity with a residual JSON predicate, so each round could traverse the idle suffix. The `26d2df9` repair uses the matching filtered `spine_own_events` index and tests a 2,000-row suffix/malformed row. Also price the predicate/index maintenance on appends and the one-time migration scan. Holder-only queries can still have O(snapshot) map or global pending-compaction work.
- **Rendering:** fences cap input characters, not escaped output bytes. Check preparation before the fence: #187 normalizes whole event text and prepares inline candidates even for file-only batches. `invalid_text` counts every raw character; accepted grammar caps do not cap malformed-input work.
- **Cached conversion:** "once per plan" means once after a successful version write. #187 legacy v2 reconstruction still follows record/batch size; failed persistence can repeat that work on later ticks.
- **Counting:** no new executable site is not an invariant total launch count. #186 can add changed-document ddocs work or turn a no-release into one existing writer commit. #188 removes a temporary listener, not a child process.

Keep scope explicit: source establishes complexity; exact-head CI establishes exercised behavior; a feature-off baseline is not its new CPU cost. Never let a performance pass clear another role's block.

Current requests, holds and raw reading pointers live in handover `48ef970f`, not this durable lesson.
